name: TeleStream
subtitle: Telegram Video & Audio Streaming Player
description: Official repository source for TeleStream - Fast native iOS Telegram streaming player.

apps.name: TeleStream
apps.versionDescription: v1.61: Fixed: player looping between "Locating Video" and "Buffering" when resuming after a force-close • Fixed: extra progress bar from the built-in MKV player that never went away • New playback speed panel: clean preset grid plus fine-tune -/+ (0.05x steps) • Smoother audio at 0.25x-3x speeds, and the chosen speed now sticks after pause/seek • Bigger buffer for MKV/AVI/WebM so faster speeds don't stutter
apps.localizedDescription: TeleStream is a fast and native iOS streaming player powered by TDLibKit to stream and play media from your Telegram chats, channels, and cloud storage.

versions.localizedDescription: v1.61: Fixed: player looping between "Locating Video" and "Buffering" when resuming after a force-close • Fixed: extra progress bar from the built-in MKV player that never went away • New playback speed panel: clean preset grid plus fine-tune -/+ (0.05x steps) • Smoother audio at 0.25x-3x speeds, and the chosen speed now sticks after pause/seek • Bigger buffer for MKV/AVI/WebM so faster speeds don't stutter

v1.60: Fixed: videos from History/Recents not playing after the app was force-closed (no more clearing history to make playback work) • Fixed: pinch-to-zoom / fill-screen not working on MKV, AVI, WebM and TS videos • Fixed: pinch gesture often swallowed by the volume/brightness swipe • Fixed: next/previous episode not switching the video for MKV files (and when switching between MKV and MP4) • Fixed: stream server could send empty data after a restart, causing endless buffering • Fixed: stream server staying dead after the app was in the background • Fixed: "Clear Video Cache" leaving Telegram's file database out of sync and breaking playback • Fixed: wrong or missing thumbnails in History/Recents after a restart • "Max cached videos" and "Download whole video first" settings now actually work • Old history entries are automatically repaired and keep their watch progress
